generator.params.note: Hand-set from general knowledge of the species: a massive conifer with a broad, buttressed base, level branches with hanging branchlets and stiff, sharp needles all round the twigs; fast-growing on wet ground near the coast. Not fitted to measurements.

allometry.note: Rough sizes from general knowledge of the species: 36 m tall and 60 cm across at breast height at 60 years in a closed stand. Replace with measured data before calling this species calibrated.

appearance.note: Colours chosen by eye: blue-green needles with silvery undersides; thin grey-brown bark in small scales.

sources.title: Project After contributors: hand-set species values

provenance.notes: Procedural proxy from the step-6 catalogue, authored from general knowledge of the species in the south Puget Sound lowlands. Calibration against measurements and photographs is milestone P4.
